headline: What are you building?
intro: Ameristar makes everything from backyard ornamental fence to crash-rated barriers for critical infrastructure. Tell us who you are and we'll get you to the right products, tools and people.

cards.title: Homeowners
cards.body: Ornamental steel and aluminum fence for yards, pools and driveways, with a lifetime of low maintenance.

cards.title: Contractors & Installers
cards.body: Installation guides, product availability, dealer locator and the tools to quote and build faster.

cards.title: Architects & Engineers
cards.body: Specs, CAD and BIM files, crash ratings and system drawings. No forms, no gates — download what you need.

cards.title: Distributors & Partners
cards.body: Customer extranet, online pricing tool, order status and marketing assets for Ameristar partners.
